body:
## Problem

When a breaching charge was placed at the corner/intersection between two walls, neither wall would be opened on detonation. Only the single nearest wall was stored, so the other wall at the corner remained intact and blocked passage through the corner.

## Root Cause

`_find_nearest_wall_with_hit()` returned only **one** wall — the nearest collider across all 8 ray directions. At a corner, two wall bodies may each be hit by different rays, but only one was stored in `_charged_wall: Node`. On detonation, `_open_wall_passage()` was called only for that single wall.

## Fix

- Renamed `_find_nearest_wall_with_hit()` → `_find_walls_with_hits()` which collects **all unique wall nodes** hit across all 8 ray directions (nearest hit per unique node, sorted by distance)
- Changed `_charged_wall: Node` → `_charged_walls: Array` to store multiple walls
- `try_place_charge()` now stores all found wall results; placement marker still uses the primary (nearest) wall's hit position and direction
- `detonate()` iterates over all `_charged_walls` and calls `_open_wall_passage()` for each — so both walls at a corner get a passage carved

## Tests

Added 5 new unit tests in `tests/unit/test_breaching_charges_effect.gd`:
- `test_corner_placement_stores_two_walls` — verifies both walls are stored at corner
- `test_corner_detonation_opens_both_walls` — verifies both walls are opened
- `test_corner_detonation_clears_both_charged_walls` — verifies state cleared after detonation
- `test_corner_detonation_emits_single_detonated_signal` — only one signal fires per detonation
- `test_single_wall_placement_still_works_after_refactor` — regression test for normal single-wall case

Closes #1093

Issue: https://github.com/Jhon-Crow/godot-topdown-MVP/issues/1093

When a breaching charge is placed at the corner between two walls, only
one wall's collision was opened on detonation, leaving the corner blocked.

- Replace _find_nearest_wall_with_hit() (returns 1 wall) with
  _find_walls_with_hits() (returns all unique walls within PLACEMENT_RADIUS,
  sorted nearest-first)
- Change _charged_wall: Node → _charged_walls: Array to store multiple walls
- Update try_place_charge() to store all found wall results
- Update detonate() to call _open_wall_passage() for each charged wall
- Add unit tests for corner placement (two walls stored, both opened)

Closes #1093
